title: Short-Sale Other-Cost Allowance by Property Type
content:
Other seller closing costs on a short sale — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

**Rule.** On the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, the short-sale other-cost allowance, part of the allowed closing costs, is the contract other costs up to 3.5 percent of the contract price for a two-to-four-unit property, and up to 3.25 percent for an FHA-approved condominium or planned unit development property, as the property type is recorded under the Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) product. Every other property, and a Summit loan, takes no adjustment under this rule.

| Property type recorded on the HECM | Other-cost limit |
|---|---|
| two-to-four-unit property | 3.5 percent of the contract price |
| FHA-approved condominium | 3.25 percent of the contract price |
| planned unit development | 3.25 percent of the contract price |
| any other type, or a Summit loan | no adjustment under this rule |

*Hypothetical:* on a USD 300000.00 contract for a duplex, the limit is USD 10500.00, so contract other costs of USD 11000.00 are allowed at USD 10500.00 and the seller covers USD 500.00; on the same price for a condominium the limit is USD 9750.00.
